verdict.rationale: The pack shows feature-level guides: a first-call guide with a streaming toggle, a JSON Output guide, and a function-calling guide with runnable examples. None of it documents official cookbooks or worked examples of real end-to-end tasks beyond per-feature snippets. Pointing users to third-party tools like Claude Code as a backend is a no-code integration, not a worked example, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
